# S12 material host candidate — finite independent acceptance

2026-10-31. **The current development-tree host slice passes the reviewed normal and host-race boundaries. This is not release-tree/CLI acceptance or full S12 completion.** No product, ledger, source execution, Go execution or network operation was performed by this reviewer.

## Source → actual host

The fixed `8a83efe...` `DownloadChain.download_torrent` operation reaches the ordinary installed SDK through the current resource dispatcher, exact invocation/installation authority, source-shaped wrapper, dedicated material transport, persistent helper cache and real notice/log writers. It does not submit a downloader task or create download history.

- Identity, generation, capability and invocation checks remain before/after the resource operation. `prepare` also checks frozen site/ProxyHost authority before/after acquisition. Subsequent immutable byte pages retain invocation authority; they do **not** introduce per-page site-configuration revocation.
- Source-supplied Cookie is allowed for the configured origin without an invented equality requirement against stored Cookie. Origin binding, cross-origin stripping, indirect-stage Cookie omission and existing transport guards remain. Disabled configured sites are not newly prohibited.
- Private App cache lifetime spans calls and cold reopening. App shutdown closes it only after admitted work drains. SDK paging preserves the existing full 16 MiB logical byte capacity rather than shrinking it through base64 framing.
- E2 consumes helper text-decoding failures only where the source reads text (GET, status 200, relevant marker). Descriptor lazy consumption is preserved. Actual 503/unknown-charset/marker returns source None plus its real notice/log, not a spurious decoding exception.
- Missing `Location` now raises classified `KeyError`, before a second GET or failure notice. The original while-loop observation independently records 301 and 302 raising at source line 111. This is a selected-source-component observation, not execution of the full source HTTP/helper stack. The actual App gate verifies owned HTTP 301, typed SDK exception, no matching notice and same-worker recovery.

## Actual evidence, including failures

| Gate | Actual result | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| `s12-app01` | Compile PASS; four roots FAIL | Setup `/` traffic, public SDK error classification and log projection assumptions were wrong. Original raw evidence retained. |
| `s12-app02` | Compile PASS; three PASS, one FAIL | Values/authority/recovery, persistent cache/notice/log cold reopening, and full bytes PASS. Cancellation expectation conflicted with delivered legacy-serial drain semantics. |
| `s12-app03` | Changed fourth root PASS | 6,197 declared inputs equal before/after compile/after test and current readback; actual program SHA verified. |
| `s12-app-race01` | Two roots PASS, no race warning | Cache/cold history and scope/serial drain; 6,206 declared inputs equal across three stages/current. App binary race-built; child workers remain normal fixture02 binaries. |

Normal coverage is **three retained App02 roots + one corrected App03 root**, not four newly rerun roots. The retained functions/helpers are byte-identical through the first 24,659 bytes; all prior declared inputs except the changed App test file were independently unchanged at the inheritance check. Failed runners lack their own after-test maps; later independent readbacks are not relabelled as runner third phases.

Actual worker observations include complete 33,554,432 bytes across two 16 MiB SDK calls, exact digests, 36 counted SDK callbacks, one material fetch, warm cache and a fresh worker after cold reopening. Callback counts are not physical wire-byte measurements. Persistent notices are inspected through the actual API/protected SQLite record; source-text logs and canonical attributed logs are checked separately, retaining original IDs across reopening.

Caller cancellation on this ordinary **serial** worker deliberately does not terminate an already admitted exchange. After explicit owned-peer release, it drains, caches the complete material, rejects the cancelled outer HTTP response, preserves worker identity, and denies the expired callback. This is not immediate cancellation propagation or a negotiated-concurrent worker test. The independently accepted material transport gates retain their separate cancellation evidence.

## Remaining release boundary

The CLI candidate02 driver (`4108d175...`) is statically ready: exact held-child `127.0.0.1:39123` controller, fixed synthetic peer, no forwarding/CONNECT, no proxy/CA rewrite, one installation, two normal hosts and actual worker identities. **It has not been accepted as executed by this report.** A release-only tree excluding unrelated S06 work must bind its own actual dependencies and required integration/normal-server evidence.

The explicit 16 MiB resource limit is a source difference, not unbounded Python parity. Source recording-component evidence is not promoted to real source HTTP/cache/notice execution. No browser, RSS/browse, actual site credentials, downloader, full platform or delivery claim is made. At the reviewed finite host boundary, no additional concrete product blocker remains open; release execution remains separate.

Machine bindings and original failure references are in `host-candidate-final-seal.json`.
